courses.title: Awaken the Healer Within: 8 Shamanic Tools for Self-Healing
courses.description: A recorded online course in three modules, teaching eight shamanic practices: rattle, drum and sound work for calming tension, clearing and calling back one's energy, and first steps in the shamanic journey to meet a spirit ally. Open to beginners, with lifetime access.
courses.price: 147 € incl. VAT / $163 incl. VAT, or 3 payments of 57 € / $63
